classes.name: AppError
classes.docstring: Business-rule failure. `code` is a stable key the UI translates (en/hi).

classes.name: Consent
classes.docstring: Who consented to a support profile for a student under 18, and when.

classes.name: StoredFile
classes.docstring: Uploaded document, encrypted at rest inside the database (10 MB cap enforced on upload).

classes.name: StudentProfile
classes.docstring: Support profile. Every disability-related field is optional and encrypted.

sections.title: This is NOT the Next.js you know

classes.name: UTCDateTime
classes.docstring: Always hands back timezone-aware UTC. SQLite drops tzinfo; Postgres keeps it.

functions.name: can_edit_profile
functions.docstring: Oversight roles, assigned staff, or the student themselves once they are an adult.

functions.name: visible_student_ids
functions.docstring: Ids of students this user may see. None means "all" (oversight roles).

functions.name: require_student_access
functions.docstring:
Load a student the user may see, or fail. 404 for both "missing" and "not yours"
so that record existence is not revealed.

functions.name: activate_guardian_links
functions.docstring: Called once a guardian has proved their email address: pending invitations become active.

functions.name: append_only_ddl
functions.docstring: Trigger DDL per dialect. Used by create_all (below) and by the Alembic migrations.

classes.name: EncryptedBytes
classes.docstring: Binary column encrypted at rest. The audit log never records values of this type.

functions.name: require_roles
functions.docstring: Server-side RBAC gate. Use on every router or route that is not public.

classes.name: DevEmail
classes.docstring: Dev outbox. Only written when SMTP is not configured and env is not prod.

functions.name: register
functions.docstring: Same response whether or not the email is known, so accounts cannot be enumerated.

functions.name: refresh
functions.docstring: Sliding session: called by the frontend on activity; an expired token cannot refresh.

functions.name: reset_password
functions.docstring: Also how invited staff set their first password; a valid emailed code proves the address.

functions.name: is_minor
functions.docstring: Under 18. An unknown date of birth is treated as a minor, so consent is never skipped.

functions.name: decode_token
functions.docstring: Session token. Single-purpose tokens (below) carry a "typ" and are never a session.

functions.name: create_purpose_token
functions.docstring:
Short-lived token for one action (file upload/download), issued after an access check.
It lets the browser send or fetch a file directly from the API without a session cookie.

functions.name: make_user
functions.docstring: Create a verified user directly and return (user, auth headers).

functions.name: last_code
functions.docstring: Read the newest 6-digit code out of the dev outbox.

classes.name: Widget
classes.docstring: Test-only audited model, so the audit listener can be tested before real modules exist.

functions.name: _back
functions.docstring: Send the browser back to the page it came from (a signed, same-site path) with a result.

functions.name: upload
functions.docstring: Plain HTML form post (works without JavaScript); answers with a redirect back to the page.

variables.name: PDF
variables.value_preview: b'%PDF-1.4 disability certificate for the student'

functions.name: record_consent
functions.docstring:
Consent for a student under 18: given in-app by a linked guardian, or recorded by staff
from a paper form. Either way we keep who consented and on what date.

classes.name: ConsentIn
classes.docstring: Guardians consenting in-app send nothing; staff recording a paper consent fill all three.

classes.name: ProfileIn
classes.docstring: Every field is optional - a student decides what, if anything, to disclose.
